digest: A single failed VPN login attempt for user m.alvarez was immediately followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same IP address and registered device. This pattern is consistent with a user mistyping their password.

evidence_findings.title: Failed VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A single failed VPN authentication attempt was recorded for user m.alvarez from IP address 198.51.100.24 at approximately 08:03Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This event indicates an incorrect password attempt.

evidence_findings.title: Successful MFA-Confirmed VPN Login
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: One minute after the failed attempt, user m.alvarez successfully logged into the VPN from the same IP address 198.51.100.24, with MFA confirmation, at approximately 08:04Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The successful login with MFA from the same source suggests the user corrected a password error and successfully authenticated.

evidence_findings.title: Contextual Information
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: Notes indicate the failed attempt was due to a 'password mistyped once' and the successful login was from 'the user's registered laptop and usual home address'. No other failures for this account were observed in the preceding 30 days.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This context strongly supports the conclusion of a benign user error rather than a malicious brute-force or credential stuffing attempt.

attack_chain.description: An attempted initial access via VPN authentication failed due to an incorrect password.

remediations.description: Educate user m.alvarez on password best practices and careful entry to avoid repeated failed login attempts.
